newsitem.title: EGYPT: Seven children die in Egyptian house collapse.
newsitem.headline: Seven children die in Egyptian house collapse.

text.p: A house owner lost all his seven children, aged between 14 and five, plus his mother when their house collapsed in south Egypt on Monday, security sources said.
The owner, Abdel Hamid Hussein Abdel Ghaffar, was unhurt but his wife was seriously injured, the sources said.
The two-storey house collapsed after a wall from the adjacent building fell on it in a town in the province of Beni Suef, some 100-km (60-miles) south of Cairo, they added.

Cairo has been plagued with buildings collapsing either because of age or technical faults. The authorities recently started campaigns against violators in the construction sector in an attempt to save lives.
